ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountBalance_TRY] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
AS(
SELECT
BTT.CounterParty_ID AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE
    WHEN BTT.product_type LIKE 'Bond%' AND BTT.book = 'Client' AND BTT.bundle_type <> 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.tradestatus = 'VERIFIED' 
    AND BTT.maturity_date > GETDATE() THEN 'Fixed Income Product Outstanding' 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BOOK in ('F_Intl_MM_Team1',  'F_Intl_MM_Team2',  'R_Dom_MM_Team1', 'R_Dom_MM_Team2', 'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing') 
    AND btt.bundle_type <> 'PYA' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Money Market Product Outstanding'
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA' 
    AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding' 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding'
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' AND BTT.MATURITY_DATE > GETDATE() THEN 'Structured Product Asset Swap'
    END AS BalanceTypeId
,DATEADD(DAY,-1,BTT.INSERT_DTTM) AS [TIMESTAMP]
,CASE
    WHEN BTT.product_type LIKE 'Bond%' AND BTT.book = 'Client' AND BTT.bundle_type <> 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.tradestatus = 'VERIFIED' 
    AND BTT.maturity_date > GETDATE() THEN BTT.NOMINAL 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BOOK in ('F_Intl_MM_Team1',  'F_Intl_MM_Team2',  'R_Dom_MM_Team1', 'R_Dom_MM_Team2', 'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing') 
    AND btt.bundle_type <> 'PYA' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN BTT.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA' 
    AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN BTT.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT 
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND BTT.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN BTT.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
    WHEN BTT.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%' AND BTT.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP' AND BTT.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' AND BTT.MATURITY_DATE > GETDATE() THEN BTT.NOMINAL END AS BalanceAmount 
,BTT.TRADE_CURRENCY AS IsoCurrencyCode
,'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode
,BTT.Insert_Dttm AS INSERTDTTM
,BTT.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
from busc.TRY_TRADES BTT
WHERE BTT.CounterParty_ID IS NOT NULL and BTT.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance
WHERE BalanceTypeId IS NOT NULL;


--INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[BalanceTypeId]
,[Timestamp]
,[BalanceAmount]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
)
SELECT
DISTINCT
SRC.[CustomerAccountId]
,SRC.[BalanceTypeId]
,SRC.[Timestamp]
,SUM(SRC.[BalanceAmount]) AS BalanceAmount
,SRC.[IsoCurrencyCode]
,'TRY' AS [SourceSystemCode]
,0 AS [WorkFlowId]
,0 AS [TaskRunId]
,SRC.[InsertDttm]
,SRC.[FinancialInstitutionId]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance SRC
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance TGT WHERE 
    SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    AND SRC.BalanceTypeId = TGT.BalanceTypeId
    AND SRC.Timestamp = TGT.Timestamp
    AND SRC.IsoCurrencyCode = TGT.IsoCurrencyCode
    AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
    AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
    )
GROUP BY SRC.[CustomerAccountId]
,SRC.[BalanceTypeId]
,SRC.[Timestamp]
,SRC.[InsertDttm]
,SRC.[FinancialInstitutionId]
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountBalance;

END

WITH CustomerAccountBalance AS(
SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance 
WHERE BalanceTypeId IN ('Fixed Income Product Outstanding','Money Market Product Outstanding','Structured Product PYA Outstanding','Structured Product Asset Swap')
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRY' AND IsoCurrencyCode = 'PHP')

,CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation AS(
    select AccountID,
    count(ShareIndicator) as CNT
    from DW.DimCustomerAccount where ShareIndicator = 'Y'
    group by AccountID
)

,Balance AS (
SELECT
	convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) AS BusinessDateSK
	,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
	,DDBANK.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
	,DDA.AccountId AS AccountID
	,SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) AS OutstandingInvestmentFull
	,SUM(BCAB.BalanceAmount) / CNT AS OutstandingInvestmentProrated
	,BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode AS Currency
	,BCAB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId 
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM CustomerAccountBalance BCAB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNT BCA ON BCAB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCAB.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDB ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDB.BRANCHID aND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DIMBANK DDBANK ON BCAB.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDBANK.BANKID
LEFT JOIN CNT_CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP ON BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCAP.AccountId --join for count
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = DDA.ACCOUNTID AND BCAB.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = DDA.SOURCESYSTEMCODE AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE convert(varchar,BCAB.[Timestamp],112) between '20210101' and '20231116'
GROUP BY 
BCAB.[Timestamp]
,DDB.BranchSK
,DDBANK.BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId
,BCAB.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCAB.SourceSystemCode
,CNT
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, OutstandingInvestmentFull, OutstandingInvestmentProrated, Currency, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM Balance)

INSERT INTO DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
SELECT
    BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,OutstandingInvestmentFull
    ,OutstandingInvestmentProrated
    ,Currency
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm

FROM Distinct_Balance A
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment B
    WHERE B.AccountId  = A.AccountId
    AND B.BusinessDateSK = A.BusinessDateSK
    AND B.BankSK = A.BankSK
)
